description: Buy (or upgrade) your Defici agent plan with no human: method "spt" pays with a Stripe Shared Payment Token your wallet granted to Defici (EUR; for monthly auto-renewal use recurring_interval=month and max_amount >= 2 x price); method "approved_card" charges the card your operator approved once (POST /api/v1/billing/operator-approval), inside the monthly cap. Prices EUR/month: starter 3.49, pro 8.99, business 24.49. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe.
name: buy_plan
